note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on data retention policy, covering Field History Tracking, Field Audit Trail (Shield), Recycle Bin, and Mass Delete as the relevant Salesforce mechanisms. No screenshots per this course's screenshot policy. Specific retention-period figures (field history ~18-24 months; Field Audit Trail active/archive windows; Recycle Bin ~15 days) are cited as typical/commonly-documented ranges rather than guaranteed constants, since third-party sources show some variation and Salesforce documentation itself notes these can change by release -- the guide phrases them as 'typically' or 'commonly cited' rather than as fixed guarantees.
